ncrs.title: Porosity in aluminum housing
ncrs.description: X-ray found pore clusters at the last-to-fill zone near the mounting boss. 21/240 pcs NG, lot LOT-DC-2507, DC-03. Release-agent residue seen on vent area. Found at final inspection.
ncrs.containment: Lot LOT-DC-2507 on hold; 100% X-ray of stock.
ncrs.confirmedRootCause: Vent channel blockage confirmed by tooling inspection.
ncrs.correctiveAction: Clean vent channels every 400 cycles; add vent inspection to setup checklist.

ncrs.title: Housing voids after tool change
ncrs.description: X-ray deteksi void internal di area boss tebal setelah ganti dies. 14/320 pcs NG di lot LOT-DC-2602, DC-05. Pembacaan vacuum di HMI lebih rendah dr resep. Temuan QC patrol.
ncrs.confirmedRootCause: Incorrect vacuum timing confirmed by parameter log comparison.
ncrs.correctiveAction: Lock validated vacuum recipe and verify first-off samples.

ncrs.title: Shaft diameter outside tolerance
ncrs.description: SPC chart shows gradual upward trend in shaft diameter, 11/200 pcs above upper limit, lot LOT-CNC-2611, CNC-07. Insert had a long run without change. Found at final inspection.
ncrs.containment: Suspect parts segregated, shipment blocked, 100% gauge check.
ncrs.confirmedRootCause: Tool wear confirmed by measured insert condition.
ncrs.correctiveAction: Introduce tool-life limits and in-process gauging.

ncrs.title: Surface scoring on drive cover
ncrs.description: Bekas gores di permukaan cover di lokasi yg sama tiap part. 9/160 pcs NG di lot LOT-AS-2622, line A2. Bekas cocok dgn titik kontak fixture. Komplain customer, minta 8D.
ncrs.containment: Stok di customer disortir; WIP dikarantina sampai leak test dan electrical test.
ncrs.confirmedRootCause: Fixture contact point confirmed through controlled reproduction.
ncrs.correctiveAction: Replace fixture pads and add visual checks.

ncrs.title: Seal leak during end-of-line test
ncrs.description: End-of-line leak test fails at seal interface, 7/240 pcs NG, lot LOT-AS-2631, line B1. Teardown shows seal twisted in groove. New operator on station 4 this week.
ncrs.containment: Lot LOT-AS-2631 on hold; 100% leak and electrical test of stock.
ncrs.correctiveAction: Add poka-yoke locator and operator training.

evidence.summary: Vent channel condition on the housing die.
Vacuum timing before and after the tool change.
Gauge R&R of the shaft diameter gauge.
Measured insert wear at the time of the defect.
Controlled reproduction of scoring on the assembly fixture.
Leak test of 30 assemblies with the locator.
